title: Benjamin Disraeli and Gladstone: The Oxford Repartee
summary: If Gladstone fell into the Thames, that would be a misfortune; and if anybody pulled him out, that, I suppose, would be a calamity!

full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring Benjamin Disraeli & William Gladstone.

"If Gladstone fell into the Thames, that would be a misfortune; and if anybody pulled him out, that, I suppose, would be a calamity!"

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
